# Divider: `jl-divider`

A line between groups of content, across or up and down, with an optional label.

- Class `JlDivider`, an atom: `import { JlDivider } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/divider

A divider separates groups that belong to the same surface: sections of a form, items of a menu, the
buttons of a toolbar. Between surfaces, a card's border or some space usually reads better.

It is a separator for screen readers, named by its label when it has one.

## Use

```ts
import { JlDivider } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlDivider label="or" />
```

```html
<jl-divider label="or"></jl-divider>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. A word on the line.
- `vertical` (attribute `vertical`): `boolean`, default `false`. Up and down, for rows.
- `align` (attribute `align`): `'start' | 'center' | 'end'`, default `'center'`. Where the label sits.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The separator.
- `--color` (custom property): The line colour.
- `--thickness` (custom property): The line width.
- `--gap` (custom property): The space between the line and the label.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A line

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <span>Profile</span>
  <jl-divider></jl-divider>
  <span>Notifications</span>
</div>
```

### With a label

A word on the line; at the start or the end, it reads as a section heading.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-divider label="or"></jl-divider>
  <jl-divider label="Today" align="start"></jl-divider>
  <jl-divider label="Earlier" align="end"></jl-divider>
</div>
```

### Vertical

Up and down, between items of a row: it takes the height of the row.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="pencil" hint="Edit"></jl-button>
  <jl-button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="copy" hint="Duplicate"></jl-button>
  <jl-divider vertical></jl-divider>
  <jl-button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon="trash" hint="Delete"></jl-button>
  <jl-divider vertical></jl-divider>
  <span class="muted">Saved 2 min ago</span>
</div>
```

### In a form

The usual place of a labelled divider: between two ways to sign in.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-button icon="globe" label="Continue with SSO" block></jl-button>
  <jl-divider label="or"></jl-divider>
  <jl-input type="email" placeholder="you@company.com" label="Email"></jl-input>
  <jl-button variant="primary" label="Continue with email" block></jl-button>
</div>
```
